title: Quantum computing
summary: New ways to process information. New questions for science.
description: Quantum computing investigates how properties of quantum systems can be used to process information. Hardware, software, and firmware meet in a field that requires fundamental research and collaboration across specialties.

title: Communication and cryptography
summary: Knowledge to shape the future of communication and security.
description: Quantum communication and post-quantum cryptography are distinct approaches. The first uses physical properties of quantum systems; the second develops classical cryptographic algorithms designed to withstand attacks from quantum computers.

title: Quantum sensors and materials
summary: Observe with precision to discover possibilities.
description: Quantum sensing explores quantum properties to perform measurements. Materials research seeks to understand and develop physical properties. These fields connect fundamental science with application questions through partner institutions and laboratories.

title: Algorithms and optimization
description: Quantum algorithms and hybrid methods are studied for computation and optimization problems, including applications in healthcare and other sectors.

title: Quantum for business
summary: A bridge between research, organizations, and society.
description: Understanding emerging technologies also involves education, management, and dialogue. This field brings scientific knowledge closer to the questions faced by organizations while respecting each technology's maturity level.

title: Quantum in law
summary: Connecting quantum technology evolution with legal and social questions.
description: Quantum in law promotes interdisciplinary dialogue on the legal, ethical, and institutional implications of quantum technologies. Research topics include data protection, information security, intellectual property, and the regulatory and governance challenges associated with technological transformation.
